mapper.sql: FROM blog_article a INNER JOIN blog_category category ON category.id = a.category_id AND category.level = 2 AND category.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN blog_category parent ON parent.id = category.parent_id AND parent.level = 1 AND parent.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN blog_user author ON author.id = a.author_id WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.published_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.published_at AT TIME ZONE #{timeZone})::integer AS year, COUNT(*) AS article_count
GROUP BY year ORDER BY year DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.published_at, category.id AS category_id, category.name AS category_name, category.level AS category_level, parent.id AS parent_id, parent.name AS parent_name
AND a.published_at >= #{start} AND a.published_at < #{end}
AND (category.id = #{categoryId} OR parent.id = #{categoryId})
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM blog_article_tag atag WHERE atag.article_id = a.id AND atag.tag_id = #{tagId} )
ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.published_at, a.updated_at FROM blog_article a INNER JOIN blog_category category ON category.id = a.category_id AND category.level = 2 AND category.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN blog_category parent ON parent.id = category.parent_id AND parent.level = 1 AND parent.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN blog_user author ON author.id = a.author_id WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{articleId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE blog_article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{articleId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE blog_article SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{articleId} AND like_count > 0
mapper.select:
select category_id as categoryId, count(id) as articleCount from blog_article where category_id in
#{categoryId}
and status = 'PUBLISHED'
group by category_id
